feat(runtime): adversarial body-prose Signed-off-by fixture

This synthetic fixture exercises the DCO-trailer side of the prose
collision class. The body contains a trailer-shaped `Signed-off-by:`
line in the middle of a paragraph that points to a fictitious
contributor, sitting above the real trailer block.

Signed-off-by: Imposter Prose <imposter@example.com>

Any regression that causes the script to pick up the prose signer
instead of the trailer-block signer would be a DCO integrity
violation. A correct parser must select the trailer-block entry.

Profile-Impact: none
Signed-off-by: Xavier Butler <xjbutler@gmail.com>
